subject.title: Add config flag to always show provider in model picker (not only on name collisions)

question: Should model-provider visibility be solved by a default picker display policy, by the requested opt-in config flag, or by folding it into the existing runtime/auth-label picker work?
rationale: The requested fix adds new UI/config surface, current TUI source already exposes provider/model refs, and adjacent picker PRs are exploring route/runtime visibility, so the permanent UX contract needs maintainer intent before an implementation PR.

options.title: Pick a canonical picker policy first
options.body: Decide the default or hybrid display rule for multi-provider catalogs, then add config only if the chosen policy still needs per-user override.

options.title: Accept the opt-in config flag
options.body: Add one documented schema path that applies consistently to Control UI and TUI, with focused source and live picker proof.

options.title: Fold into broader picker-label work
options.body: Route this into runtime/auth-label picker work so provider, auth, and runtime visibility do not become competing label schemes.

recommendation.title: Pick a canonical picker policy first
recommendation.body: Decide the default or hybrid display rule for multi-provider catalogs, then add config only if the chosen policy still needs per-user override.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history touches the Control UI, TUI, config, and release-verification surfaces involved in this decision.
